direction: Compact housing with stock-proportioned side and rear setbacks. Preserve the observed number of separate houses and approximate storeys; do not replace a cluster with one large home. Keep useful gaps between houses and a little space around exposed windows. No excessive empty perimeter margin or uniform paved garden.
stock_spacing: Visible garden/yard at sides and front; building occupies only part of the plot. Do not enlarge it across the usable yard.
